intro: Pattaya Beach is the main beach and the heart of Koh Lipe — fine white sand, clear water, where the speedboats land and Walking Street runs right alongside · Z-Touch Lipe Island Resort sits right on it: a 3-star resort with unusually spacious rooms (around 38 sqm), a few steps from the sea, the pier and Walking Street's restaurants · if you want a quiet sunset spot, Sunset Beach is about a 10-15 minute walk across the island · ideal if you want to be in the centre of the action, easy for both sightseeing and food · from approx THB 1,700/night · scores 8.0 from 33 reviews.

body.html: Koh Lipe has three main beaches — busy Pattaya Beach, the main beach, quieter Sunrise Beach, and the smallest and calmest of all, Sunset Beach · Z-Touch Lipe Island Resort planted itself right on Pattaya Beach, where the boats land and the island's centre of gravity sits · The beach out front is fine white sand and clear water, a few steps from your door · The upside is convenience — the pier, Walking Street and restaurants are all right alongside, while a quiet sunset spot at Sunset Beach is about a 10-15 minute walk across the island.

The thing guests mention most is room size · Rooms here run around 38 sqm across every category — from Sea Breeze (queen bed) and Garden View (king bed) to the Two Bedroom Family room — noticeably larger than similarly priced options elsewhere on the island · All rooms have air-con, a TV, a safe, an en-suite bathroom with shower, and free drinking water · The feel is garden bungalow by the sea rather than a hotel block, and with only 36 rooms it never feels crowded.
"The room was far bigger than expected, and a few steps from the door you're on the beach — right by the sea and close to everything on the island. Convenient and beautiful."

Another point that earns steady praise is the staff and service · Many guests describe a warm welcome, with the owner and team helping arrange snorkelling boat trips around Lipe at reasonable prices · Breakfast also gets good mentions, with American and Continental options and a Halal menu · There's a beachfront restaurant on site, plus kayaking and snorkelling that launch straight off the beach in front.

Here's the honest part — condition and upkeep · This is a long-established resort, and a fair share of reviews reflect that it's showing its age · Guests mention dated rooms, low water pressure in some units, and a few reviews go as far as saying it needs serious renovation · It's worth knowing before you book — the appeal here is the central Pattaya Beach location, spacious rooms and service, not pristine newness · Note too that the resort has no swimming pool; if a pool matters to you, look elsewhere.

Getting here: reaching Koh Lipe means a roughly 1.5-hour speedboat from Pak Bara or Tammalang pier (Satun) · Boats land at Pattaya Beach, the main arrival point, and the resort sits right on Pattaya Beach — so it's just a few-minute walk from the drop-off to the property (the resort can help with luggage) · Immigration (for those continuing to Langkawi), the pier and Walking Street's restaurants and bars are all right alongside · Z-Touch scores 8.0 from 33 reviews on Trip.com, with location and cleanliness rated highest.

To be straight about it, Z-Touch isn't the newest or fanciest resort on Lipe · If you're after modern design, a pretty pool or flawless interiors, other island options do that better · But if what you value is a central Pattaya Beach location, spacious rooms, the sea and Walking Street a few steps from your door, and attentive staff at a still-accessible price, this is one of the best-value picks right on Pattaya Beach — perfect for travellers who want to be in the centre of the island and easily head out diving and snorkelling.

A tip from reading the reviews: ask for a renovated room or one in the beachfront zone, and flag water pressure when you book if you're sensitive to it · Bring mosquito repellent and a power bank — it's a garden-bungalow setting and island power can be limited in spots · High season (November–April) is Lipe's main travel window, when rooms fill fast and prices climb; in low season many places on the island close, so check the resort's opening dates and book with free cancellation.

honestSummary: Z-Touch Lipe Island Resort suits travellers who value a central Pattaya Beach location, walk straight out to the pier and Walking Street, paired with spacious 38 sqm rooms and attentive staff at a still-accessible price · But accept that it's a long-established resort — some rooms are dated and need updating, and there's no swimming pool. It isn't the choice if you want pristine modern rooms or a full set of facilities.
honestChecks: If you want pristine modern rooms or flawless interiors — this is a long-established resort and some rooms are dated → ask for a renovated room, or consider one of the island's boutique options in this series.
If a swimming pool matters to you — there's no pool here; it's all about swimming off Pattaya Beach → if you need a pool, pick one of the resorts with one in this series instead.

If you're travelling in low season (May–Oct) — Lipe's monsoon months see many island businesses close and boats reduce service → always check the resort's opening dates and the boat schedule before booking.

faq.q: Where is Z-Touch Lipe Island Resort and how do I get there?
faq.a: It's on Pattaya Beach, the main beach of Koh Lipe in Satun Province — where the boats land and the island's centre sits · Reaching Lipe means a roughly 1.5-hour speedboat from Pak Bara or Tammalang pier (Satun) · Boats land right at Pattaya Beach, so it's just a few-minute walk from the drop-off to the resort · Sunset Beach is about a 10-15 minute walk across the island.

faq.q: How much does Z-Touch Lipe cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Prices start at around THB 1,700/night for a Sea Breeze Room in normal-season pricing · There's also a Garden View Room (king bed) and a Two Bedroom Family Room, all around 38 sqm · Rates depend on the season — high season (Nov–Apr) climbs fast, so compare platforms and book ahead.

faq.q: Who is Z-Touch Lipe best for?
faq.a: Best for travellers who want to be right on Pattaya Beach in the centre of the island, easy for sightseeing and food, plus spacious rooms at an accessible price · Great for couples or anyone who spends the day diving and snorkelling and wants to stay near the pier and Walking Street · Not ideal if you need pristine modern rooms, contemporary design, or a swimming pool.

faq.q: What is Pattaya Beach on Koh Lipe like?
faq.a: Pattaya Beach is the main beach and centre of Koh Lipe, fine white sand and clear water, where the boats land and Walking Street with its restaurants runs right alongside · Ideal if you want to be in the middle of everything · For a quiet sunset spot, Sunset Beach is about a 10-15 minute walk across the island.

faq.q: Are the rooms dated? Is there a pool?
faq.a: It's a long-established resort, so some rooms are dated and need updating, with low water pressure in a few units, and there's no swimming pool — swimming is off Pattaya Beach · Its strengths are location, spacious rooms and service rather than newness · Ask for a renovated room and bring mosquito repellent.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, and is it open in low season?
faq.a: Lipe's high season is November–April, when rooms fill fast and prices rise — book 2–3 months ahead · Low season (May–Oct) is the monsoon, when many island businesses close and boats reduce service, so always check the resort's opening dates and boat schedule first · All platforms offer Free Cancellation — choose that if your plans aren't fixed.
